source.description: Evidence extracted from the uploaded legacy TCL scripts and LabVIEW VI resource heaps.
source.confidence_note: These profiles record historical software behavior. They do not prove that the present physical wiring to PHAROS LX13 is unchanged.

hxp_legacy_labview.evidence: The same address, port and timeout constants occur throughout the uploaded HXP LabVIEW VIs.

pockels_candidate.evidence: HEXAPOD_FRONT_PANEL_v3.vi contains the comment 'Pockels Cell control and Control During Writing motion' and repeated GPIODigitalSet nodes on GPIO3.DO with mask 1 and values 0/1.
pockels_candidate.note: The VI establishes the channel and two states, but the extracted heap evidence alone does not prove which state physically opens the present PHAROS Pockels path.

gate_state_marker.evidence: GPIO set to 0.vi and GPIO set to 4.vi use GPIO1.DO mask 4 values 0/4; GPIO Monitoring.vi reads GPIO1.DO and labels it 'Gate Open?'; MoveStartEvent.vi and MoveEndEvent.vi configure GPIO1.DO.DOToggle for HEXAPOD.1.SGamma.MotionStart/MotionEnd.
gate_state_marker.interpretation: This strongly resembles a writing/gate-state marker used for plotting/recording and motion-event synchronization.

gpio4_observation.evidence: HEXAPOD_FRONT_PANEL_v3.vi contains a GPIODigitalSet node on GPIO4.DO near the writing-line logic.
gpio4_observation.note: Do not assign a physical role from this observation alone.

power_control.evidence: HEXAPOD_FRONT_PANEL_v3.vi contains GPIOAnalogGet on GPIO2.DAC1, two VISA Configure Serial Port nodes with COM7, and Power Setpoint/Power Control front-panel controls.
power_control.note: The actual COM7 device command protocol is not recoverable with high confidence from the extracted strings alone.

beam_control.evidence: Power_Speed_Sweep.tcl, powerino.tcl and density.tcl repeatedly set GPIO4.DO 1 1 before the writing line and GPIO4.DO 1 0 afterwards.
